name: comp-99
blurb: An icon button (plus icon) with a minimal tooltip on hover.
description: Icon button wrapped in a tooltip that shows a label on hover. Useful for accessibility on icon-only buttons.
use_when: Icon buttons that need text labels for clarity and accessibility.
avoid_when: Buttons that already have visible labels.
a11y: Button has aria-label; icon is aria-hidden; tooltip provides additional context.
